notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a creature, creating four Treasure tokens and four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Ruthless Knave's second ability.
